Evaluate the following statement using only the passage, choosing an assessment with a sound justification:

Eva had no financial interest in the contract, assuming the rule was followed.

options.label: A
options.textMd: Not deducible: the passage does not settle it.

options.label: C
options.textMd: True, because Eva is not a board member.

options.label: D
options.textMd: True: it follows from the passage.

explanationMd: Under compliance, an interested member would abstain. Voting therefore excludes the interest condition by contraposition.
